Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET AND IMMUTABLE MASTER COMPOSITION. Input image 2 is a COLOR SAMPLE ONLY, never a pose or geometry reference.
This is a local recoloring operation, NOT a new product photograph and NOT a new composition. Change ONLY the medium-gray ALUMINUM CASE, its crown and side button to Jet Black polished glossy deep neutral black, following the COLOR ONLY of image 2. Keep the exact same silhouette and all boundaries of image 1, and keep the current matte charcoal-black silicone band exactly unchanged. The watch display must remain the identical BLUE luminous 10:09 face of image 1; do not copy the white face from image 2.
Mandatory invariants: keep image 1's exact square canvas dimensions, background pixels, all diagonal light stripes and tabletop reflection in place; exact camera angle, watch rotation, apparent size, width, height, center position, perspective, band loop shape, negative spaces, holes, metal pin, crown location, side button location, glass perimeter, and every display pixel. The case and band must remain at the very same pixel coordinates as image 1. Do not enlarge, shrink, stretch, tilt, translate, crop, change framing, or regenerate the watch. Keep the display identical to image 1 and untouched; change only the specified material colors. Same pin-and-tuck smooth silicone Sport Band. Preserve realistic shading and surface details. No text outside display, no border, no additional object. Return one square edited image.
